svg.title: Zenagamtide phase 3: when each trial’s main results are due
svg.desc: Timeline of the 15 phase 3 zenagamtide trials on ClinicalTrials.gov as of October 24, 2026, from start to estimated primary completion. The earliest primary completion is AMAZE 12 on June 6, 2028; the obesity trial AMAZE 1 is due June 26, 2029; the heart outcomes trial AMBIENCE is due September 16, 2030. Novo Nordisk has named 2029 as zenagamtide’s potential launch year.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
